Council approves new cycle lanes

The city council voted on Tuesday to build twelve kilometres of protected cycle lanes along the river. The mayor called it "the biggest change to our streets in a generation" and promised that work would start in the spring.

Shop owners on Mill Road were less enthusiastic. "We lose forty parking spaces," said one baker, "and nobody asked us." The council says delivery bays will stay open before 10am.

The plan is described in the full proposal, which also lists the junctions that will get new signals.
